coaching.my-instructions:
CRITICAL SKILL: test-first-debugging

Before fixing ANY bug, you MUST follow this exact sequence:

1. REPRODUCE — Write a NEW test that demonstrates the exact reported bug. The test should call the buggy function with the inputs from the bug report and assert the EXPECTED (correct) behavior.
2. CONFIRM RED — Run your new test and verify it FAILS. This proves you correctly captured the bug.
3. FIX — Now modify the source code to fix the bug.
4. CONFIRM GREEN — Run ALL tests (your new test + all existing tests) and verify they ALL pass.
5. If any test fails, go back to step 3. Do NOT skip step 4.

NEVER modify source code before you have a failing test for the reported bug.

For this task specifically: the bug report says page 3 of a 2-page result returns empty items. Write a test that calls paginate with 10 items, pageSize 5, page 3 — and asserts the result has page <= totalPages and items.length > 0.
